SOURCE STORY:
Amy cooks breakfast for Will and Amber wearing a black tank top and denim jeans. A zombie breaks the kitchen door window. Amy rushes Will and Amber into the basement and locks the door. She retrieves a pistol and katana. The majority of the film is Amy killing, dismembering, and decapitating zombies as they attack her. Amy kills the last zombie, leaving the house soaked in blood, then lets Will and Amber out of the basement.

MAJORITY REPAIR RULE:
When the source describes a plural/repeated process but does not enumerate enough ordinary instances to fill the required majority, allocate additional ordinary instances of that same process across beats rather than treating those unnumbered instances as new plot. Use distinct threat entity names for distinct attackers. Preserve the explicit last/final instance as the terminal sequence beat.
